commandId.description: The client-generated UUID every command takes; a retry with the same id applies once.

accountId.description: The adopted account whose directory to carry over.

dryRun.description: Answer the report of what an import would do, and write nothing.

skills.description: The card's skills tick: run skills.carryOver with the same dry run, copying the directory's skills and commands into the own directory, its report joining this one's.
